conclusion: The tested field-output routes support exact field omission and decoder-mediated scaling, not Bob. The 1280-wide whole-picture Weave path is mislabelled TOPFIELD by the existing library. Separately pinned source candidates accept the measured full payload without weakening compact-field pairing or picture ownership. The later finite MBAFF prefeed fix completes all 750 decoder pictures and real EOS; explicit live gap/end/reconnect also passes. Kodi completes all admitted field pairs, but its full-source presentation and physical A/V remain unqualified. Installed production behavior is unchanged.
